subject.title: fix(ui): adapt background-tasks rail to narrow panes

question: Which branch should own the background-tasks responsive-layout fix now that this PR is mergeable but defective and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104107 is better proven but conflicting?
rationale: Automation cannot safely close this PR against a conflicting replacement or choose which contributor branch maintainers want to preserve; the branches should be consolidated before further implementation churn.

options.title: Refresh the proven branch
options.body: Resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104107 against current main and retain its corrected grid placement, focused tests, and browser screenshots.

options.title: Adopt proof into this branch
options.body: Fix this PR's row placement, port equivalent responsive tests, attach real browser proof, and close the competing PR only after this branch becomes the clearly viable path.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both PRs open temporarily while an area owner decides the desired grid composition and asks one author to consolidate.

recommendation.title: Refresh the proven branch
recommendation.body: Resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104107 against current main and retain its corrected grid placement, focused tests, and browser screenshots.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most direct merged history and authored the canonical issue and proof-positive candidate branch.
